learning_outcomes.text: Students independently apply the knowledge acquired during their studies so far. They are able to identify the relevant knowledge bases for the respective task and, if necessary, expand them independently. Students can adequately communicate work results in written and oral form (project report, presentation). Students know essential aspects of project management. Students are able to adequately plan challenging tasks and adapt the planning to the project progress. They can define project goals and coordinate them with the client of the project.

Students have in-depth knowledge in the field of the electrical engineering task and can transfer and apply this to other tasks. They know fundamental aspects of project management and can apply them in technical projects.

Students are able to evaluate the competencies acquired during their studies in a professional project context and apply them appropriately. They are able to select appropriate procedures and approaches suitable for the problem and apply them to solve the task.

Students can independently research solution approaches and apply the acquired knowledge to the task. They can analyze a problem, divide it into sub-aspects, and design the resulting interfaces so that the identified sub-problems can be worked on in a group.
Students independently check self-formulated hypotheses using suitable subject-specific methods to solve the tasks.

Students can present the project topic and discuss problems and solution approaches appropriately in the project group. They can demonstrate and present the developed insights and results. Students can utilize heterogeneous teams, including cultural, social, or professional differences of other team members, to achieve team results.

syllabus_topics: Technical content from electrical engineering according to changing tasks

assessment_methods.method: Demonstration and explanation of project results

assessment_rules: The graded examination consists of a project report of approximately 25 pages and a demonstration and explanation of project results lasting approximately 15 minutes. The specific weighting of these components is not provided.
